verdict.rationale: IAM docs show JSON permission policies attachable to identities or resources. They cover nine policy types, including identity-based, resource-based, VPC endpoint policies and permissions boundaries, which together make resource-scoped least privilege expressible. However, the pack never shows condition keys or the policy evaluation logic, so those parts of the story rest on inference. Missing for 10: evidence of condition elements in policies, documented policy evaluation logic (explicit deny / allow precedence), independent or hands-on corroboration.
